factors.name: Post-distribution selling pressure window
factors.description: Initial 90-day price dip where indexers and institutional parent holders dump shares indiscriminately.

factors.name: Spinoff relative capitalization size
factors.description: Spinoff equity is under 20% of parent equity, maximizing neglect and forced institutional selling.

factors.name: Clean spinoff balance sheet leverage
factors.description: Spinoff has conservative leverage (D/E <= 0.50), ensuring parent did not dump toxic debt onto the spinoff.

factors.name: Direct insider ownership and incentive alignment
factors.description: Officers and directors own at least 5% of shares outstanding, directly aligning incentives with equity upside.
